sources.for: DE 2/7 types permitted on procedure 71, DE 2/3 document codes, DE 3/39 authorisation type codes
DE 2/7 general format and the full type list including non-customs warehouse types

de_2_7_identificationOfWarehouse.obligation: A (mandatory) on H2 — the data element that exists on no other import category
de_2_7_identificationOfWarehouse.format: One type letter (a1), then the warehouse reference number or warehouse ID (an..35) which carries the authorising country code
restrictions: Warehouse types S and T may not be used with any warehouse ID carrying a country code of GB or XI (Appendix 1, procedure 71).
All goods items on one declaration must be entered to the SAME warehouse.
For imports to Northern Ireland, GB in DE 2/7 is restricted to excise premises and certain legacy customs warehouse diversions; everything else must use XI (Group 2 completion guide).
de_2_7_identificationOfWarehouse.discrepancy: The Group 2 completion guide states only that S and T may not be used with GB. The procedure 71 page, which is more recent and more specific, extends that to GB or XI. The procedure page is taken as authoritative; verify before relying on it for an XI submission.

de_2_3_authorisationDocumentCodes.identifier: Country code + CWP + the customs warehouse authorisation number
Country code + CW1 + the customs warehouse authorisation number
Country code + CW2 + the customs warehouse authorisation number
de_2_3_authorisationDocumentCodes.restriction: CW2 must not be used with GB or XI

de_3_39_authorisationTypeCodes.meaning: Authorisation for a private customs warehouse
Authorisation for a public customs warehouse type 1
Authorisation for a public customs warehouse type 2
de_3_39_authorisationTypeCodes.restriction: Cannot be used with GB or XI

de_3_39_note: The authorisation TYPE code and holder EORI go in DE 3/39; the corresponding authorisation DECISION number goes in DE 2/3 against the matching document code. The two must be declared as a pair.

de_2_2_additionalInformationCodes.declare: Full name, address and country of the warehouse where the goods can be examined, with the premises country code suffixed after a hyphen
de_2_2_additionalInformationCodes.condition: Do NOT complete PREMS if the premises code in DE 2/7 is a UK-allocated warehouse

de_2_2_additionalInformationCodes.meaning: Preference to be claimed on removal
de_2_2_additionalInformationCodes.declare: The type of preference claimed, for example GSP, ACP, EFTA
de_2_2_additionalInformationCodes.condition: Used when a preferential rate will be claimed on removal from the warehouse. DE 4/17, 5/16 and, where appropriate, 5/15 must also be completed at entry.

de_5_27_supervisingCustomsOffice.note: The office applicable to the customs warehouse authorisation held. It appears in the authorisation letter.
